Header.title: 3-hourly output (3hr)
Header.comment: CORDEX attempts to adapt as much as possible to CMIP5. Therefore, the specifications of the variables requested for the CORDEX archive, which until now are laid down in a file CORDEX_variables_requirements_table.xls will be formatted as is the 'standard_output.xls' spread sheet provided by the CMIP5. The names of the sheets for the atmospheric variables remain unchanged in order not to necessitate a renaming of the CMOR MIP tables. The names of the sheets with oceanic variables will be the same but with a capital 'O' prepended. The sheet 'all' will be kept, and any specification in that sheet will be pointed at in the other sheets. The base version is of 21 Feb 2014, Version 3.1, SVN revision 6378 in http://svn-mad.zmaw.de/svn/mad/Model/DOCs/cordex_specs.
